newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mark slips below 63.74 yen, lowest in nearly 2 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Mark slips below 63.74 yen, lowest in nearly 2 yrs.

text.p: The mark fell below 63.74 yen in late Tokyo trade on Monday, its lowest level in nearly two years, traders said.
The mark slipped as low as 63.71 yen due to persistent downward pressure on the German currency amid fears of a weak single European currency, traders said.
Mark selling for the yen was led by overseas players, traders said.
A trader at a Japanese city bank said Tokyo operators expect mark/yen to fall further if a support point slightly above 63 yen does not hold.
